856-4321-8249-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-8249-8347.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

3188-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

3591-7792.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library face down.
Repeat step 1 as desired / able.
At the beginning of your end step, Necropotence triggers, putting the exiled cards into your hand.
Move to your cleanup step, discarding down to your maximum hand size.
Cool but Rude's second ability triggers for each card discarded, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each card discarded.

215-850-4742.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-4742.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

283-4186-5189-5296.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, targeting Scurry Oak
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Ghave's ability, targeting Workhorse.
Resolve both Ghave abilities, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3258-4013-7417.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using Eldrazi Displacer. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
3258-4013-7417.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

240-4742-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7330.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Mikey & Mona.
When Mikey & Mona dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4934-5060-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
4934-5060-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2366-3430-5223-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-5223-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-5220-6634-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1456-4050-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
1456-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-647-677-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2014-3055-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Yosei.
When Yosei dies, it and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Yosei trigger, causing the next player in turn order to skip their next untap step.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Yosei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
At the beginning of the end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Yosei.
Repeat during each turn unless you are the next player in turn order.

2577-2999-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-2999-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

5078-5705-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-5705-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat

1563-1849-2457-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1563-1849-2457-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3263-5346-6520.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
2034-3263-5346-6520.notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
2034-3263-5346-6520.description:
Declare two creatures you control as attackers, attacking two different opponents.
Holding priority, activate Nemesis Phoenix by paying {2}{R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nemesis Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Nemesis Phoenix dies, Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

277-5702-5954-6441.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
277-5702-5954-6441.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-5702-5954-6441.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tiller Engine each trigger twice.
Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the lands.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2523-5256-5561.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Relentless Rohirrim.
When Relentless Rohirrim dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Relentless Rohirrim that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Relentless Rohirrim token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Relentless Rohirrim token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1170-1171-1879.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-1879.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

2079-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2079-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

654-2034-3875-5552.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten permanents.
654-2034-3875-5552.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Temple of Cultivation.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

803-4385-4434-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
"Treefolk" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-4385-4434-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
When the Sliver enters the battlefield as a Treefolk due to Arcane Adaptation, Quickbeam triggers, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
